selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline healthy state before change (cmdline, grub config, auditd, boot_id)
selected_evidence.summary: Captured original /proc/cmdline (no audit=1), /etc/default/grub, BLS status, auditd active with auditctl -s output, and baseline boot_id 55595e92-... prior to any change or restart

selected_evidence.requirement: audit=1 persisted into boot configuration for all kernels
selected_evidence.summary: Updated /etc/default/grub, ran grubby --update-kernel=ALL --args=audit=1, regenerated grub2.cfg; grubby --info=ALL confirms args include audit=1 for both the running kernel and rescue kernel

selected_evidence.requirement: Node restart executed safely, one node at a time, acknowledgement returned before disconnect
selected_evidence.summary: Issued backgrounded sudo reboot on node1; command returned 'reboot acknowledged' before the node disconnected

selected_evidence.requirement: Proof of changed boot identity (not just elapsed time)
selected_evidence.summary: boot_id changed from 55595e92-e932-451b-ac1d-75d72072b358 (pre-reboot) to 669ea8e7-d744-4830-9b48-a1078a8ab2de (post-reboot), proving an actual kernel restart occurred

selected_evidence.requirement: audit=1 actually active on the running kernel post-reboot
selected_evidence.summary: Live /proc/cmdline after reboot shows '... audit=1' appended, confirming the kernel booted with the parameter

selected_evidence.requirement: Required service (auditd) healthy and recovered after restart
selected_evidence.summary: Post-reboot systemctl is-active auditd returns 'active' and auditctl -s shows enabled=1, matching pre-reboot health, and grub config/grubby confirm audit=1 remains set for the default kernel for future boots

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== STEP: capture baseline =="
BASELINE_BOOTID=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
echo "boot_id=$BASELINE_BOOTID"

echo "== STEP: update /etc/default/grub =="
sudo -n cp /etc/default/grub /etc/default/grub.bak
if grep -q '^GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX=' /etc/default/grub; then
  sudo -n sed -i 's/^GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX="\(.*\)"$/GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX="\1 audit=1"/' /etc/default/grub
fi
grep '^GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX=' /etc/default/grub

echo "== STEP: grubby persist across all kernels (BLS) =="
sudo -n grubby --update-kernel=ALL --args="audit=1"

echo "== STEP: regen grub.cfg (BIOS) =="
sudo -n grub2-mkconfig -o /boot/grub2/grub.cfg

echo "== STEP: verify BLS entries =="
sudo -n grubby --info=ALL | grep -E "^(kernel|args)="

echo "== STEP: verify kernelopts in grubenv =="
sudo -n grep -o 'kernelopts=[^"]*' /boot/grub2/grubenv || true

echo "== STEP: verify default kernel args include audit=1 =="
sudo -n grubby --default-kernel
DEFAULT_KERNEL=$(sudo -n grubby --default-kernel)
sudo -n grubby --info="$DEFAULT_KERNEL" | grep args=
